reviews.text: Brought my dog for vaccines and Noel was so nice to us and helped us get everything done super quickly, she treated me and my baby with much care and kindness. I recommend anyone searching for a vet to come here and ask for her to be your technician.
Tamara did a great job! Noel helped with our nail trim.
Fantastic experience for 5 kittens. Tamara was kind, informative and just great. Highly recommend
Awesome mobile vet service on the weekends fair prices and Tam is always so helpful and kind with my fur babies. Very professional
Tam did a fantastic job. I have been coming here for years and all of the doctors and techs are great!

We had a great experience at MPC of Texas! Tam was our vet, and she was absolutely wonderful! She was super sweet, friendly, and helpful throughout our visit. She made us feel comfortable and took great care of our dog. We really appreciated her kindness and how easy she made the whole experience. Thank you so much, Tam! We’ll definitely be coming back! 😊

MPC goes above and beyond to ensure your pets are taken care of! Maureen, thank you for going the extra mile to make sure our cat got his vaccinations, we really appreciate you and everyone on staff. We are lucky to live across the street from one of the Saturday mobile clinics — we have also visited the brick and mortar office and have had all positive experiences, including a dental & echocardiogram for our chihuahua, thank you Brian!
Tam was very nice excellent service thanks

Today we brought a tiny feral kitten that we found in our neighborhood. The first place I thought MPC because we have been bringing our pets to their mobile clinics for years. It’s so convenient to have somewhere to go, and they They have many locations all over San Antonio and outside of San Antonio.
Great service by Tam.
Tam was wonderful! I have been coming for years and they always take great care of our dogs.

Have  used the mobile pet many many times
Everyone is kind and understanding
Reasonable prices!
I trust them with my 2 dogs
I highly recommend them!!!❤️
We have been using MPC of Texas for many years for all four of our digs and we will not go anywhere else. The quality of care here is uncontested.

Brian and Noel were amazing taking care of my 3 foster kittens! I was desperate to find a clinic that did a stand alone combo test on the weekend that I could afford, and finally found MPC! I’ve met Brian before at another visit and he is always kind & professional, he did my intake and test, and was so sweet to my scared little kittens, they loved him, thank you! Noel helped draw the test and she was kind, professional, and caring! The Dr did a thorough exam and was also excellent! The entire visit from start to finish was great! Now these sweet kittens are one step closer to a furever home! Thank you so much!
Quick easy and efficient thank you Tamara!
Tamara was our technician today with our pet Sophie. We appreciate the business.
Thanks so much for taking the time to rate us!
I ❤️ MPC vet. We take our cats to both their mobile clinics and vet clinic. Both Dr. Pinney's are fantastic and so is the technicians. I highly recommend them.
Did some follow-up. Sorry we were unable to provide the service you were looking for
The prices are reasonable, and it's an excellent option for pet care. Bryan, an excellent veterinary technician, gave my little ones, Cookie Crumb and Argos, a thorough check-up 👍🏻

First time visit. I have never done a review but I was so happy with the experience. Husky went in for skin infection. All staff were kind and professional-husky gave Kaleb our tech her seal of approval. He was wonderful with her. Dr. was thorough and informative-husky liked him a lot too. Will be my vet place from now on. Super affordable.
We are so glad we have the option of seeing Dr Pinney and his staff. We get a good look over of both our dogs and vaccines are very affordable. We save so much money coming to the mobile pet clinic.

I recently visited this clinic,  been a long time customer for at least 20 years,  although still very convenient not to mention affordable and overall satisfactory service something was amiss , I  learned Dr Pinney had retired,  his presence,  his character and his way with people was amazing every single time , still wishing he has a happy retirement. Thank you Dr Pinney for your incomparable service
